contests.title: Athens School District — Temporary revenue-limit increase
contests.scopeNote: Applies to this school district in Marathon and Taylor counties.

provenance.quote: Shall the School District of Athens, Marathon and Taylor Counties, Wisconsin be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $600,000 per year for four years, beginning with the 2027-2028 school year and ending with the 2030-2031 school year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of operational and maintenance expenses?

contests.title: Edgar School District — Temporary revenue-limit increase

provenance.quote: Shall the School District of Edgar, Marathon County, Wisconsin be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $1,400,000 per year for five years, beginning with the 2027-2028 school year and ending with the 2031-2032 school year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of facility maintenance and operational expenses?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Temporarily lets Athens School District exceed Wisconsin’s state revenue limit by $600,000 each year for 4 school years, from 2027-2028 through 2030-2031, for operating and maintenance expenses.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the district to exceed its revenue limit by $600,000 a year for those 4 school years and purposes.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not authorize this proposed increase above the state revenue limit.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Temporarily lets Edgar School District exceed Wisconsin’s state revenue limit by $1,400,000 each year for 5 school years, from 2027-2028 through 2031-2032, for facility maintenance and operating expenses.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the district to exceed its revenue limit by $1,400,000 a year for those 5 school years and purposes.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not authorize this proposed increase above the state revenue limit.
